title: Learning stochastic multiscale models through normalizing flows
summary: Many systems in physics, engineering, and biology exhibit multiscale stochastic dynamics, where low-dimensional slow variables evolve under the influence of high-dimensional fast processes. In practice, observations are often limited to a single trajectory of the slow component, while the fast dynamics remain unobserved, making statistical learning challenging. Approaches based on partial differential equations (PDE), such as Fokker-Planck formulations, aim to characterize the evolution of probability densities, typically requiring dense space-time data or grid-based solvers.
